title: Leaving Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN): Exit Terms
content:
Leaving Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) is the seller's own decision and is confirmed by the seller. After an exit request the seller must remove the remaining units within the exit removal deadline counted in calendar days from the exit request date; units still on hand after it are disposed at the seller's cost at the disposal fee. An exit request may be withdrawn only while units remain on hand. The enrollment closes when units on hand reach zero. Storage fees continue to be billed for every storage month in which units remain.

## The exit deadline per program

In each of FBN Starter Program, FBN Core Program, FBN Growth Program, FBN Scale Program, FBN Premier Program and FBN Enterprise Program, the exit deadline is that program's exit removal deadline, counted in calendar days from the exit request date.

## Statuses along the way

| From | To | By | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| active or inbound suspended | winding down | the seller | the seller asks to leave FBN |
| winding down | active | the seller | the seller withdraws the exit request while inventory is still on hand |
| winding down | closed | the system | all units have left the fulfillment network |

## Points of judgement

- The exit request and its withdrawal are the seller's own acts, confirmed by the seller.
- Withdrawal is possible only while units remain on hand; once units on hand reach zero the enrollment closes.
- Units still on hand after the deadline are disposed of at the seller's cost, at the disposal fee.
- Storage continues to be billed for each storage month in which units remain, including months after the exit request.

Illustration (hypothetical): a seller requests exit with 300 units on hand, removes 250 before the deadline, and 50 remain after it; those 50 are disposed of at the disposal fee at the seller's cost, and the storage month in which they were still held is billed.
